source: Fresh session metadata from configured ACPX copilot profile (sessions show)
note: This runtime advertises no model catalog and no reasoning-effort selector over ACP: available_models, available_model_names, current_model_id and model_control are all null. Model choice belongs to the Copilot CLI itself. It does advertise a real permission control, allow_all, which CLI-MODE applies and verifies. Its mode selector uses ACP session-mode URIs and chooses an interaction style, not a permission level; CLI-MODE pins Agent.
